input.description: A description of the UI to build — component type, layout, theme, interactive behavior

output.description: A self-contained React JSX artifact with LeafyGreen design tokens injected as CSS custom properties

domain_fields.rendering_note: LeafyGreen uses Emotion CSS-in-JS which is unavailable in artifact environments. This skill encodes the full design system as CSS custom properties and Tailwind-compatible patterns.
domain_fields.font_fallback_note: Euclid Circular A is not available on CDN. The system font stack matches its metrics.
domain_fields.accessibility_note: Green (#00ED64) NEVER used for text on white (fails WCAG AA). Use green.dark2 (#00684A) for text.

imprint.description: When used alongside the Imprint skill, LeafyGreen acts as a flavour override

overrides.component_patterns: All standard controls use LeafyGreen specs

imprint.preserved: Imprint craft principles (rhythm, accent economy, datum alignment)
